description: Labelled reuse decisions for `pnpm admin calibrate`. Each case is a request; `related` questions would be acceptable in its assessment, `unrelated` ones would not. Unrelated items are deliberately close (same field, different focus) so the margin is tested where it matters. Questions are written as the bank embeds them: the question followed by its correct option.

related: What is a tax deduction? An expense that reduces taxable income
What does a marginal tax rate apply to? The next unit of taxable income
What is a tax credit? An amount subtracted directly from the tax owed
Which form reports a US employee's annual wages and withheld taxes? Form W-2
What is withholding tax? Tax an employer deducts from wages before paying them
unrelated: What does a P/E ratio compare? Share price to earnings per share
What is diversification in investing? Spreading money across different assets
What does a central bank's policy rate influence? The cost of borrowing
What is a bond's coupon? Its periodic interest payment
What is compound interest? Interest earned on previous interest

related: What is taxable income? Gross income minus deductions and exemptions
What is a progressive tax system? Higher incomes pay higher rates
What is a standard deduction? A fixed amount that reduces taxable income
What is a tax bracket? A range of income taxed at one rate
unrelated: What is a value-added tax charged on? Each stage of production and sale
What does an auditor verify? That financial statements are fairly presented
What is a balance sheet? A statement of assets, liabilities and equity
What is a tariff? A tax on imported goods

related: What does len() return for a list? Its number of elements
How do you start a for loop over a list in Python? for item in items:
What is the result of 7 // 2 in Python? 3
Which keyword defines a function in Python? def
What type does input() return in Python 3? str
unrelated: What does a JavaScript Promise represent? A value available in the future
What does SQL's GROUP BY do? Aggregates rows that share values
What does the Java keyword final do on a variable? Prevents reassignment
What is a Rust borrow? A reference that does not take ownership
What does git rebase do? Replays commits onto another base

related: What does await do inside a coroutine? Suspends it until the awaitable completes
What does asyncio.gather run? Several awaitables concurrently
Which function starts the asyncio event loop for a coroutine? asyncio.run
What does async def define? A coroutine function
unrelated: What does a Python list comprehension produce? A new list
What does the with statement manage? A context such as an open file
What does pip install? Python packages
What does a Python dictionary map? Keys to values

related: How many chambers does the human heart have? Four
Which vessels carry blood away from the heart? Arteries
What do red blood cells carry? Oxygen
Which valve separates the left atrium and left ventricle? The mitral valve
unrelated: Which bone is the longest in the human body? The femur
What do the kidneys filter? Blood, producing urine
Where does most digestion of food occur? The small intestine
Which part of the brain coordinates balance? The cerebellum

related: In what year was the Bastille stormed? 1789
Who led the Reign of Terror? Maximilien Robespierre
What was the Estates-General? France's assembly of the three estates
Which document of 1789 proclaimed citizens' rights? The Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen
unrelated: Who was the first emperor of Rome? Augustus
In what year did the Berlin Wall fall? 1989
What started the First World War? The assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand
Which empire built Machu Picchu? The Inca

related: What does DNS translate? Domain names into IP addresses
What does an A record hold? An IPv4 address
What is a CNAME record? An alias to another domain name
What does a DNS TTL control? How long a record may be cached
unrelated: What does TCP's three-way handshake establish? A connection
What does a subnet mask define? The network part of an address
What does HTTPS add to HTTP? Encryption with TLS
What layer does a switch operate at? The data link layer

related: What makes bread dough rise? Yeast producing carbon dioxide
What does kneading develop in dough? Gluten
What is proofing? Letting shaped dough rise before baking
What is a sourdough starter? A culture of wild yeast and bacteria
unrelated: What does searing meat produce? A browned crust
What is a roux? Flour cooked in fat to thicken sauces
What is the main ingredient of hummus? Chickpeas
What does blanching vegetables involve? Brief boiling then cooling
